organization.name_ja: 株式会社2りんかんイエローハット

affected.note: Final figure from the June 2026 final report. The second report of 2026-05-01 had given a maximum of 3,455,754 people. Affected were point, mobile and app members of the motorcycle goods chain, a subsidiary of Yellow Hat. Credit card data was stored separately and not affected.

summary.en: 2rinkan Yellow Hat, a Yellow Hat subsidiary that runs motorcycle goods stores, detected unauthorized access to a members-only server on 2026-04-20 and suspended some app services. Its final report in June stated that member data of 3,179,454 people, including names, addresses, phone numbers and birthdates, had leaked.
summary.ja: イエローハットの子会社でバイク用品店を運営する2りんかんイエローハットは、2026年4月20日に会員専用サーバーへの不正アクセスを検知し、アプリの一部サービスを停止した。6月の最終報で、氏名、住所、電話番号、生年月日などを含む3,179,454名分の会員情報が漏えいしたと公表した。
